---
agent: speckit.checklist
---

# Purpose

Generate a QA readiness checklist.

# Output

Generate checklist.md

The checklist should verify:

Requirements
Requirements complete
Business rules documented
Acceptance criteria defined
Specification
No ambiguities
No contradictions
Assumptions identified
Permissions documented
Test Design
Functional coverage
Negative coverage
Boundary coverage
Validation coverage
UI coverage
Permission coverage
Test Readiness
Test data prepared
Environment available
Risks documented
Dependencies resolved

The output should be a Markdown checklist using checkboxes (- [ ]).
